option_relations.rationale: Foreign body aspiration is a distinct condition from chronic bronchitis. While it could lead to complications, it is not a type or cause of chronic bronchitis.
Obstructive pneumonia due to a foreign body is a distinct diagnosis and not directly related to chronic bronchitis.
Post-obstructive pneumonia secondary to an endobronchial lesion is a distinct diagnosis and not directly related to chronic bronchitis.
Pneumonia is a general term for lung inflammation, which is distinct from chronic bronchitis, a long-term inflammatory condition of the bronchi.
